player_prompt.intro:
Wɔyɛ Player {player_id} wɔ Chopsticks. Wɔ wo tɔn no, chɔsia yi fɔ: 
  + Kyere:  '[attack M O]'  sɛ M-yɛ wo nsamno (0 anaa 1), O-yɛ ɔkɔmfo nsamno (0 anaa 1). 
    - ɔkɔmfo nsamno mu akɔ soro pɛɛpɛɛ na wo nsamno; sɛ ɛboro 5 a, ɛbɛyɛ 0.
  + Petɛe:   '[split L R]'  maa wo nsamno no bɛyɛ L ne R (L+R = wo nsamno pɛ). 
Bɔ hɔ ama wɔyɛ yi fɔ no mu biako.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ Split bɛsesa wo nsa mu kyɛfa.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Invalid move. Use “[attack M O]” or “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} kyere P{opp_id} nsamno {opp_idx}: ɛsan kɔ firi {opp_val} kɔ {new_val}.

outcome.win: Ɔtamfo no nsa abien nyinaa awu.
outcome.draw: Wɔadu baabi a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛdan no.
